experiments.scope: One fixed family of five 128-byte two-block message pairs on the exact sha256-r31-prefix-v1 target. Each organizer trial seed deterministically selects one pair via sha256(DOMAIN + seed + trial_le4) mod 5 and returns it; the organizer recomputes both reduced-round digests. All trials, including any repeated selections, are returned; nothing is skipped.
experiments.hypothesis: Every pair the program can return is a pair of distinct 128-byte messages with equal 31-step SHA-256 digests under the organizer verifier. This evidences the collision RELATION of the replayed construction only; the attack cost is charged in proof.md and no success frequency or cost is inferred from this experiment.
